headline: 418 is now streaming on Netflix: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Telugu film, starring Chaithra J Achar, Charan Lakkaraju, Preethi Pagadala, arrived on Netflix 4 weeks after opening in cinemas on 23 October.
paragraphs: 418 is streaming on Netflix in India from 20 November.
That is 28 days after its theatrical release on 23 October — in line with the typical 28 days for Telugu films, based on 16 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.
Directed by Kiran Nadagouda, starring Chaithra J Achar, Charan Lakkaraju, Preethi Pagadala, Ramesh Indira, Shashank Patil. The film runs 157 minutes and is certified A.
New on OTT re-checks Netflix's India listing every day; the page for 418 has the latest on where to watch it.
source: 418's release announcement, as listed on TMDB; not yet confirmed by Netflix's own India listing at the time of writing.
